goal: Prevent old delayed auth submissions from overriding a newer view/account intent and guard double submit or stale error updates.
successCriteria: Switching signup A to signin B during artificial UI delay calls only B callback.
Once a request starts, the form remains visibly pending rather than allowing a competing auth intent; duplicate presses are locked synchronously.
Unmount/view change prevents stale callback UI updates; existing sign-in/up/recovery/confirmation tests pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No network adoption/auth session/storage contract change.
No live signup/login/password change or credentials.
